description: This file contains unit test code for the quic::test namespace, specifically testing the QuicUdpBatchWriter functionality, including socket creation, address support, and packet read/write operations.

classes.name: QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTestDelegate
classes.description: Abstract base class for delegate used in UDP batch writer IO tests, providing interface for skipping tests, resetting writers, and obtaining writer instances.

classes.name: QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTestParams
classes.description: Struct holding parameters for UDP batch writer IO tests, including delegate, address family, data size, and packet size.

classes.name: QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for parameterized tests of QuicUdpBatchWriter, verifying packet IO capabilities over different socket configurations.

methods.name: IsAddressFamilySupported
methods.description: Checks if a given address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) is supported by attempting to create a socket.

methods.name: CreateSocket
methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket for the specified address family, initializing the provided QuicSocketAddress.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads stream insertion operator to output QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTestParams contents.

methods.name: MakeQuicBatchWriterTestParams
methods.description: Generates a vector of test parameters for different address families, data sizes, and packet sizes.

methods.name: QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTest
methods.description: Parameterized test class that initializes sockets, performs write/read validation, and skips tests if environment does not support required features.

methods.name: ShouldSkip
methods.description: Determines whether the current test should be skipped based on system support for address family and delegate's criteria.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up sockets and addresses for testing, and resets the writer delegate.

methods.name: GetWriter
methods.description: Returns the current QuicUdpBatchWriter instance from the delegate.

methods.name: ValidateWrite
methods.description: Performs a sequence of packet writes and verifies the total bytes sent match expectations.

methods.name: ValidateRead
methods.description: Performs packet reads and verifies the contents and addresses of received packets.
